sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: The University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) and the University of Houston-Clear Lake (UH) are both public institutions but differ significantly in size and location. UNT, located in Fort Worth, has a much smaller undergraduate enrollment of 41 students compared to UH's 6,078 students in Houston. Additionally, UH charges an in-state tuition of $7,770, while tuition information for UNT is not specified. These differences highlight the distinct characteristics of each university in terms of scale and setting.
